Adaptive intelligence lifecycle

Governance model dan feedback loop
GOVERNED LEARNING

01 · Collect

Telemetry berlabel dan bukti terikat sumber.

02 · Review

Validasi analis, kualitas label, dan kontrol privasi.

03 · Evaluate

Benchmark, false positive, false negative, dan drift.

04 · Approve

Persetujuan rilis model dan kontrol perubahan.

05 · Deploy

Canary, monitoring, version pinning, dan rollback.

06 · Improve

Feedback terukur tanpa mengubah policy secara diam-diam.

Defense controls

Kontrol keamanan dan status verifikasi
REQUIRES VERIFICATION

Network enforcement

Vendor adapter, policy validation, scoped credentials, dry-run, rollback, dan post-action verification.

Identity & access

RBAC, MFA/SSO, least privilege, session control, dan review akun privileged.

Data protection

Data in use, at rest, in transit; encryption, key lifecycle, access audit, dan DLP.

Detection engineering

Rule lifecycle, test coverage, tuning, event quality, dan false-positive review.

Incident response

Approval gate, containment boundary, evidence chain, recovery, dan lessons learned.

Resilience

Backup, restore validation, high availability, degraded mode, dan recovery objectives.

KHODAM reference architecture

Autonomous, policy-governed security operations
SYSTEM DESIGN

01 · Data plane

Network sensors, endpoint agents, log collectors, packet metadata, and protected assets.

02 · Event intelligence

Parsing, normalization, enrichment, correlation, deduplication, and time synchronization.

03 · AI analysis

Behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, contextual reasoning, and explainable findings.

04 · Policy control

Deterministic policy, asset scope, allowlists, deny-by-default, and degraded-mode behavior.

05 · SOAR / response

Signed playbooks, idempotency, approval gates, bounded retries, rollback, and verification.

06 · Evidence & audit

Event lineage, immutable audit storage, evidence references, retention, and reporting.

Prinsip kendali: AI memberikan analisis dan rekomendasi. Policy engine deterministik dan operator berwenang mengendalikan tindakan berdampak tinggi. Pisahkan data plane dan control plane, terapkan least privilege, signed playbooks, kill switch, rollback, serta validasi pasca-eksekusi.

Cryptographic security profile

Recommended interoperable profiles; not a claim that every primitive is already deployed
DESIGN BASELINE
AreaRecommended profilePurposeVerification
Transport securityTLS 1.3; TLS 1.2 only where compatibility requiresConfidentiality and integrity for service communicationsRequires certificate and endpoint inspection
Symmetric encryptionAES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305Authenticated encryption for stored or exchanged sensitive payloadsRequires code/configuration verification
Password storageArgon2id with per-password salt and tuned work factorsPassword hashing, not reversible encryptionRequires authentication implementation review
Integrity / fingerprintsSHA-256 or SHA-384Evidence integrity checks and content fingerprintsRequires evidence pipeline verification
Digital signaturesEd25519 or ECDSA P-256Playbook signing, artifact authenticity, and trusted updatesRequires key-management and signature validation
Key managementOS keystore / HSM / KMS, rotation, least privilegeProtect cryptographic keys and limit exposureDeployment-specific verification required

Important: algorithms alone do not establish security. Production assurance requires secure implementation, random number generation, key lifecycle management, certificate validation, access controls, dependency review, and independent testing. Do not publish an algorithm as “used by KHODAM” until the actual code and runtime configuration prove it.

DEFENSE & PREVENTION

Autonomous AI NGFW

Lapisan pertahanan dan enforcement jaringan.

Fungsi

Inspeksi trafik, filtering, segmentasi, policy enforcement, deteksi pola jaringan berisiko, dan integrasi threat intelligence.

Response

Allow, deny, rate-limit, isolate atau quarantine melalui enforcement connector yang tersedia. Tindakan berisiko memerlukan approval dan policy guard.

Output & report

Flow decisions, rule hits, blocked/allowed flows, policy changes, enforcement status, dan evidence bertimestamp.

Input & batas operasional

Network flows, session metadata, firewall logs, asset context, IOC, dan policy. Android/Termux tanpa hak istimewa jaringan bukan inline NGFW untuk seluruh jaringan.

SECURITY INFORMATION & EVENT MANAGEMENT

SIEM · Event Intelligence

Lapisan pengumpulan, normalisasi, korelasi, penyimpanan, pencarian, dan analisis event.

Fungsi

Mengumpulkan log endpoint, server, aplikasi, identitas, cloud, network dan NGFW; parsing, normalisasi, enrichment IOC/asset, korelasi lintas sumber.

Response

Menghasilkan alert, menetapkan severity, menghubungkan event menjadi kasus, lalu meneruskan alert terpilih ke SOC dan SOAR.

Output & report

Event search, correlation alerts, timeline, detection coverage, log-source health, retention status, query/export, audit trail.

Pipeline

Collect → Parse & Normalize → Enrich → Correlate → Alert → Case/Evidence. Event idealnya memiliki source, timestamp, severity, asset/entity, rule ID, dan referensi raw event.

SECURITY OPERATIONS CENTER

SOC · Security Operations

Fungsi operasi manusia dan teknologi untuk monitoring, triage, investigasi, eskalasi, dan koordinasi insiden.

Fungsi

Monitoring sesuai cakupan layanan, validasi false positive, prioritisasi risiko, investigasi lintas sumber, case ownership, dan eskalasi.

Response

Assign analyst, enrich kasus, koordinasi pemilik sistem, minta containment, eskalasi incident commander, dan verifikasi hasil tindakan.

Output & report

Case queue/status, analyst notes, SLA/MTTA/MTTR jika terukur, escalation log, shift handover, situational report, executive summary.

Alur kerja

Monitor → Triage → Investigate → Classify → Escalate/Coordinate → Validate closure → Lessons learned. SOC adalah fungsi operasional, bukan hanya dashboard.

SECURITY ORCHESTRATION, AUTOMATION & RESPONSE

SOAR · Orchestration

Orkestrasi workflow lintas tools dan otomasi tindakan berbasis policy.

Fungsi

Menghubungkan alert SIEM, threat intel, asset inventory, ticketing, endpoint, firewall dan notifikasi.

Response

Enrichment IOC, pembuatan tiket, notifikasi, pengumpulan evidence, approval, dan pemanggilan containment melalui connector.

Output & report

Playbook execution history, action result, approval record, connector health, automation success/failure, durasi, audit log.

Safety controls

Setiap action memiliki prasyarat, scope, timeout, rollback/compensation plan, approval threshold, dan verifikasi pascatindakan. Jangan menyatakan berhasil sebelum connector mengonfirmasi.

INCIDENT RESPONSE & GOVERNANCE

IR Playbook

Prosedur respons insiden yang dijalankan SOC secara manual atau diorkestrasi SOAR dengan kontrol persetujuan.

Fungsi

Menetapkan tahapan, peran, severity, decision gate, bukti wajib, komunikasi, dan kriteria penutupan untuk setiap jenis insiden.

Response

Prepare → Detect & Analyze → Contain → Eradicate → Recover → Post-Incident Review. Perubahan sistem mengikuti otorisasi.

Output & report

Incident action log, chain of custody, evidence register, timeline, impact assessment, notification record, recovery validation, RCA, post-incident report.

Playbook inti

Malware/ransomware: validasi → identifikasi host → isolasi terotorisasi → preservasi bukti → eradikasi → pemulihan tervalidasi → review.

Account compromise: validasi aktivitas → batasi sesi/akun sesuai approval → reset kredensial dan periksa MFA → audit → pulihkan akses → review.

Data exfiltration: validasi indikator → identifikasi data/jalur → koordinasi legal, privacy dan data owner → containment terotorisasi → preservasi bukti → penilaian dampak dan pelaporan.

Ini adalah kerangka playbook; status eksekusi hanya tampil setelah aktivitas tercatat.

Konfigurasi endpoint API KHODAM
LOCAL CONFIGURATION
Endpoint dapat disesuaikan dengan route yang benar-benar disediakan backend. Browser dapat menolak request lintas-origin jika API belum mengaktifkan CORS. Untuk operasi produksi, gunakan HTTPS, autentikasi, RBAC, dan audit server-side.
